comportamentos: Watermark position derived from the paper and centred on the page, independent of the bottom margin and signature footer: uncertain (the candidate subtracts bounds.absolute_left/absolute_bottom from the page centre and draws the text with bounds-relative draw_text inside a rotation around [0,0], so it is unclear whether the margin offsets cancel)
Text measured and centred so its position does not depend on phrase length: present (via width_of and draw_text at -width/2)
Band derived from the paper with a margin, text shrunk to fit so landscape is not clipped: missing (no shrink_to_fit, no WATERMARK_PAPER_MARGIN, a long phrase can still touch or overflow the edge)
Public watermark_band helper and WATERMARK_* constants that tests may rely on: missing
justificativa: The candidate centres the text around the stamp origin, but it has no fitting to the paper (landscape is still unprotected), it lacks the watermark_band method and constants, and its coordinate mix (absolute stamp_at versus bounds-relative draw_text) leaves the claimed independence from the bottom margin uncertain.
